note: The rows the macro's Filter removes (a zero or NULL QTY) reach the Cross Tab: a SKU group whose only stock was there gets a WEST (or NORTH, EAST) cell that Alteryx leaves NULL, and the same cells flow through the Transpose into INVENTORY_LONG's VALUE.
Translating the macro's own default (MinQty 0) instead of the 1 the parent passes keeps the zero-quantity row; it differs from case 01 in exactly one row, because NULL >= 0 is NULL in both models.
The unmatched SKU becomes NULL instead of being kept; SKU is declared NOT NULL, and the same rows reach INVENTORY_LONG.
Both outputs are keyed, so the comparison is a keyed diff and names the columns outright; a second cluster names VALUE on INVENTORY_LONG, because the same zeros flow through the Transpose.

Shows what reaching for UNPIVOT costs: the cells with no value are missing from INVENTORY_LONG, a row-presence cluster on the expected side that names VALUE because it is NULL in every one of those rows. Its scope is rows, so it can never be approved. INVENTORY_BY_WH is untouched by this edit and reports nothing.
